name: Unam Sanctam
summary: Pope Boniface VIII's bull Unam Sanctam asserts that submission to the Roman pontiff is necessary for salvation, articulating the doctrine of papal plenitude of power against Philip IV of France.

_quarry.structural_significance: Maximal claim of medieval papal sovereignty; the immediate French reaction (Anagni outrage 1303, transfer of the curia to Avignon 1309) marks the political defeat of the universalist papal monarchy.
